description: Unofficial Satori Tendo fan-art companion inspired by Haikyu!!. Independently drawn in a white-and-purple number 5 school uniform with upward red hair and expressive eyes. Original motions include playful guessing-block gestures, a rhythmic directional point, soft-ball transfer around the waist, a gentle block jump, harmless missed-catch recovery and three-direction articulated footwork. Familiar costume cues are artistic interpretations rather than newly verified official costume pixels. Not official or endorsed.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
